svg.title: One workflow spanning four applications in three languages
svg.desc: A main orchestration workflow on App1, written in Java, starts and then makes three calls. It calls two data processing activities on App2, written in Go. It calls an ML training child workflow on App3, written in Java, which runs data processing, model training and model validation activities of its own. It calls model deployment on App4, written in Go, which loads the model and sets up inference. Each call returns to App1 before the next begins, and App1 then ends.
